cost_method: Unmeasured planning allowances, same conventions as VA: full 1–4-page scan form 3 minutes/page. Container (a) = 3 base + every unaccounted row + min(5, accounted rows), one minute per verification. Container (b) = median eligible linked-form full-read cost at 3 minutes/page, without drawing an item. Whole-original fallbacks require full reads, not shortened participation reads. Native PDFs and HTML use max(2, ceil(words/250)+1), including hidden HTML sections in the DOM. Native PDF counts use local PDFKit, no source text retained. Ceil the mean unit allowance per stratum, then multiply by its fixed allocation. Separate sampled forms and linked-container items receive no unseeded overlap credit.
fallback_policy: All 19 search slices and 3 agency indexes remain covered. The two agency HTML pages lack a verified listing/body splitter: a single unaccounted full-original span conservatively requires reading every original item/section, not a claim of one source listing. Four zero-row slices and the verified empty sitemap each use a whole-document verification span to satisfy the existing nonempty complete-source-pool contract; these five spans are not filing rows. Container accounting base and applicable verification costs remain charged for all these fallbacks. No inferred omissions or completeness verdict.
limitations: Stratum means and container medians are planning allowances, not guarantees; actual seeded reads and expansion can cost more.
